extractions.value: The paper describes ophthalmoplegia as the heralding symptom of anti-amphiphysin related paraneoplastic stiff person syndrome. The patient had a prolonged 8-month inpatient admission. The authors note similarities to anti-glycine receptor antibody related PERM and recommend aggressive treatment of the underlying cancer despite low Karnofsky scores.
extractions.quote: Ophthalmoplegia heralding the onset of anti-amphiphysin related paraneoplastic stiff person syndrome ... Our case has similarities to patients described in anti-glycine receptor antibody related progressive encephalomyelitis with rigidity and myoclonus (PERM). ... We recommend aggressive treatment of the underlying cancer in this difﬁcult patient group despite low Karnofsky scores.
